PLAN EVERY DIMENSION OF YOUR LEGEND

Every system that shapes your character, in one place — resolved together, the way the game actually combines them.

⚔

GEAR & UPGRADE TIERS

The full paperdoll with +0 to +10 item tiers, computed with the exact community-verified upgrade formula — down to the damage rounding.

✦

SPELL MANAGER

Build spell sets gem by gem, then write them straight into your character's own loadout file — everything else in it preserved, backup taken.

❖

BUFFS & STACKING

Self casts, group buffs, and cast-on-me from any class — with stacking lines, caps and over-cap made visible.

🜲

PET BUILDER

Pets gear by their own classes. A full pet paperdoll, slot budgets by class combo, and one-click survival or damage suggestions.

⚖

LOOT FILTER FORGE

Edit the game's AdvLoot filters — Loot, Merge, Store, Sell — with a picker that knows real in-game item ids. One entry covers every tier.

📜

MACRO LIBRARY

A socials editor with a library of 33 battle-tested macros, live command validation against all 372 EQL slash commands, and write-to-game.

♜

STATS ENGINE

HP and mana from community-calibrated class curves, validated against live characters. Caps, over-cap, and confidence flags on every number.

☼

AA, SKILLS & MORE

Alternate advancement, skill caps, focus effects, Exaltations, farm planning — fourteen tabs that resolve as one build.

BUILT FROM THE GAME'S OWN TRUTH

No guesswork dressed up as fact. The builder is honest about what it knows — and where every number comes from.

  • Spell damage, healing and focus limits decoded from the game client's own data files.
  • HP, mana and item-tier math calibrated against the community's measured curves — and validated against real live characters.
  • Import your character straight from the game's inventory export: gear, tiers, and Exaltations.
  • Every unverified value carries a visible confidence flag. Every formula is editable in Settings.

Data is community-maintained and the beta moves fast — always verify against the live game.

Captured from the live app — planning gear, spells and pets in real time.

CLAIM YOUR ARSENAL

Two ways to wield it. Your saved builds live safely in %LOCALAPPDATA%\EQLBuilder and survive every upgrade.

CREDITS & SOURCES

This planner stands on the shoulders of Norrath's scholars. Every number it knows traces back to one of these sources — visit them, and thank them.

eqlwiki.com →

The community wiki whose item, spell, mob and zone documentation forms the builder's entire offline database. Maintained by EQL players, for EQL players.
